patches.title: Start at Countertop Two
patches.principle: Begin each task by moving to countertop 2 if it exists; otherwise go to countertop 1.
patches.when_to_apply: At the very start of a task before any other actions.

patches.title: Avoid Container Search for Clean
patches.principle: For cleaning tasks, search only open surfaces like countertops and dining tables; skip containers initially.
patches.when_to_apply: When the goal is to clean and place an object and the object is not yet found.

patches.title: Complete Clean Sequence Without Interruption
patches.principle: After picking up the target object, go directly to the sink, clean it, then go directly to the destination and place it.
patches.when_to_apply: When holding the target object that needs to be cleaned.
